changes: Session reset commits simulation only after external reset succeeds; errors preserve state/history and discard references.
Scenario switching restores all original session bindings when a new component reset fails or is cancelled, retaining the original live plan/cache and preserving the original exception.
Forward dynamics rejects nonfinite solutions and residuals.
Opt-in soak timing records thread resource deltas and independent CPU/wall top-ten calls.
Set contact-QP ADMM alpha to 1.4 after alternating CPU/iteration comparisons and independent one-contact physical validation; retain tolerance, rho, warm start, recovery and physical acceptance.

rho_candidate.reason: Exact numerical equivalence, but paired CPU improvement varies from less than 1% in three repeats to 9-17% in two; initial wall-time comparison does not show a consistent gain. Preserve the existing unconditional rho reseed for minimal implementation change.

latency_limitations: No hard real-time guarantee. Synchronous budgets cannot interrupt a blocked stage or undo an already transmitted write.
Resource-counter deltas and an independent wall monitor provide observations, not proof of a particular host waiting cause.
session_soak_scope: Repeated 400-step session cycles across four backend combinations and five scenario configurations; a reset failure is injected every 100 steps, so uninterrupted segments span 2 seconds. This validates reset isolation, not long uninterrupted scenario dynamics. Separate installed-wheel 400-step disturbance-recovery acceptances exercise complete disturbance events.

wbc_timing_observations.slowest_wall_sample: 39.52 ms wall / 30.09 ms thread CPU; eight involuntary context switches; zero minor or major page faults. These counters do not identify every waiting cause.
wbc_timing_observations.slowest_cpu_sample: 38.43 ms wall / 38.43 ms thread CPU; 1350 iterations; zero context switches or page faults. Computation tails remain above 5 ms.
wbc_timing_observations.historical_waiting_events: No attribution or resolution of the previous 4.11 s and 40.75 s events is established by this WBC run.
wbc_timing_observations.scope: Before adopting alpha=1.4; same finite checks and physical acceptance.

session_soak_source_scope: The 3-hour reset-failure soak started before the scenario-switch rollback fix. Its reset implementation is identical to the final one; it does not call set_scenario. A separate 90-minute soak exercises the final scenario-switch implementation across all four backend combinations.

stage_timing_probe.scope: Exclusive top-level phase timers inside WBC; CPU/wall overhead is included. This is an attribution probe, not an uninstrumented performance benchmark.

stage_probe_scope: Use finalized sorted sample records and aggregate counters; heartbeat timing maxima are not used. Instrumented WBC phase attribution has a different denominator from the earlier whole-demo CPU profiler.

alpha_higher_comparison.decision: Higher alpha values increase mean iteration count in both controller modes. Isolated P99 gains do not compensate for worse mean cost or maximum iteration counts; preserve the current default.

data.scope: Instrumented whole-WBC CPU and wall clocks, alternating implementation order. All eps/max_iter/rho/polishing and physical acceptance thresholds are unchanged.

alpha_higher_comparison.default_source: Installed OSQP 1.1.3 osqp_api_constants.h defines OSQP_ALPHA=1.6; auxil.c validates 0 < alpha < 2.

alpha_lower_comparison.scope: Instrumented whole-WBC CPU and wall clocks, alternating implementation order. All eps/max_iter/rho/polishing and physical acceptance thresholds are unchanged.

alpha_generic_validation.scope: Eight-dimensional configuration, seven-velocity single-contact URDF; 3 friction values x 3 reserve values x 80 seeded finite pose/velocity/target cases. Every accepted torque is independently checked with constrained forward dynamics.

alpha_lowest_comparison.scope: Instrumented whole-WBC CPU and wall clocks, alternating implementation order. All eps/max_iter/rho/polishing and physical acceptance thresholds are unchanged.

alpha_selection.reason: Balanced reduction of mean/P99 CPU cost and maximum iteration counts in both H1 controller modes, with no recoveries in four alternating repeats. Lower alpha values help direct WBC but raise MPC maximum iteration counts.

accepted_frozen_wheel.scope: Frozen runtime source; final sdist/documentation still pending long-run results.

external_asset_snapshot.scope: Observed during validation; startup asset hashes were not captured for earlier workers.

native_reused_artifacts.scope: Source, headers, bindings, CMake and native pyproject match the previous accepted native artifacts; compiled extension digest matches independent installed-wheel acceptance.

timing_scope.max_wbc_ms: DynamicsDemo.step outer timer, including opt-in timing-wrapper overhead and caller argument evaluation.
timing_scope.cpu_timing: Inner calls to the original ContactWBC.solve; instrumentation prologue/epilogue are outside this clock window. Clock reads have slightly different boundaries.
timing_scope.event_matching: The outer maximum has no per-sample trace identifier and cannot automatically be matched to an inner slowest sample.

pre_guard_timing_observations.historical_waiting_scope: No attribution or resolution of the historical 4.11 s/40.75 s events is established.

session_reset_memory_scope: The fault injector restores instance reset attributes using bound methods, introducing method/self cycles in the test process. RSS is a process high-water mark and includes fault-injection lifetime overhead; it is not a library-only allocation profile.

final_wbc_physical_metric_comparison.scope: Equal simulation length and motion. This compares recorded physical extrema, not every trajectory element. Timing windows and concurrent load differ; maxima are not a paired speedup estimate.

scenario_switch_scope: PlanarDualArm TrackingSession: 400 uninterrupted steps before two failed switch attempts per cycle, resume original session, then successful MPC and WBC switches; four Python/native backend combinations. Checks preserve all prior session bindings, including populated prediction caches.

"""Wall-clock scenario transaction checks across Python/native adapters."""
import hashlib,json,resource,time
from pathlib import Path
from wholebodyx import BackendRegistry,JointMPC,KinematicWBC
from wholebodyx.native import NativeMPC,NativeWBC
from wholebodyx.session import TrackingSession
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/workspace/chase/WholeBodyX'); started=heartbeat=time.monotonic(); duration=5400
armed_role=None; error=None

def adapter(base,role):
 class Adapter(base):
  def __init__(self,*args): super().__init__(*args); self.reset_calls=0
  def reset(self):
   self.reset_calls+=1
   if armed_role==role and self.reset_calls==2: raise error
   super().reset()
 return Adapter

report={'status':'running','requested_wall_s':duration,'cycles':0,'steps':0,'failed_switches':0,'combinations':{},'initial_peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ('python/wholebodyx/session.py','python/wholebodyx/runtime.py','python/wholebodyx/native.py')},'probe_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
combinations=[(w,m) for w in ('python','native') for m in ('python','native')]
try:
 while time.monotonic()-started<duration:
  index=report['cycles']; w,m=combinations[index%4]; armed_role=None
  registry=BackendRegistry().register('probe_wbc',controller=adapter(KinematicWBC if w=='python' else NativeWBC,'controller')).register('probe_mpc',planner=adapter(JointMPC if m=='python' else NativeMPC,'planner'))
  scenario=('tracking','mpc_retargeting','disturbance_recovery')[(index//4)%3]
  s=TrackingSession('probe_wbc',mpc_backend='probe_mpc',scenario=scenario,registry=registry)
  row=report['combinations'].setdefault(w+'/'+m,{'steps':0,'failed_switches':0,'cycles':0})
  for _ in range(400): s.step(); report['steps']+=1; row['steps']+=1
  s.prediction(s.frames[0]); previous=s.__dict__.copy()
  armed_role=('controller','planner')[(index//4)%2]
  for error_type in (RuntimeError,KeyboardInterrupt):
   error=error_type('injected scenario reset failure')
   try: s.set_scenario('mpc_retargeting' if scenario!='mpc_retargeting' else 'disturbance_recovery')
   except BaseException as caught: assert caught is error
   else: raise AssertionError('failed switch was accepted')
   assert s.__dict__.keys()==previous.keys()
   assert all(s.__dict__[key] is value for key,value in previous.items())
   report['failed_switches']+=1; row['failed_switches']+=1
  s.step(); report['steps']+=1; row['steps']+=1
  assert s.steps==401 and s.failure is None
  armed_role=None; s.set_scenario('mpc_retargeting'); assert s.steps==0
  for _ in range(50): s.step(); report['steps']+=1; row['steps']+=1
  s.set_scenario('cartesian_circle' if index%2==0 else 'coordination')
  for _ in range(50): s.step(); report['steps']+=1; row['steps']+=1
  report['cycles']+=1; row['cycles']+=1
  if time.monotonic()-heartbeat>=30:
   heartbeat=time.monotonic(); print(json.dumps({'wall_s':heartbeat-started,'cycles':report['cycles'],'steps':report['steps'],'failed_switches':report['failed_switches'],'peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}),flush=True)
 report['status']='passed'
except BaseException as exc:
 report['status']='failed';report['error']=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}';raise
finally:
 report.update(wall_s=time.monotonic()-started,peak_rss_kib=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
 Path('/tmp/wholebodyx-20261020-scenario-soak.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(report,indent=2),flush=True)

"""Wall-clock endurance of session reset failure across independent backends."""
import hashlib,json,resource,time
from pathlib import Path
from wholebodyx.session import TrackingSession

root=Path('/home/ubuntu/workspace/chase/WholeBodyX')
output=Path('/tmp/wholebodyx-20261020-session-soak.json')
started=heartbeat=time.monotonic(); duration=10800
report={'status':'running','requested_wall_s':duration,'steps':0,'reset_failures':0,'cycles':0,'combinations':{},'initial_peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ('python/wholebodyx/session.py','python/wholebodyx/runtime.py','python/wholebodyx/native.py','python/wholebodyx/hardware.py')}}
combinations=[(w,m) for w in ('python','native') for m in ('python','native')]
scenarios=('tracking','mpc_retargeting','disturbance_recovery','cartesian_circle','coordination')
try:
 while time.monotonic()-started<duration:
  w,m=combinations[report['cycles']%4]; scenario=scenarios[(report['cycles']//4)%5]
  s=TrackingSession(w,mpc_backend=m,scenario=scenario)
  key=f'{w}/{m}/{scenario}'; entry=report['combinations'].setdefault(key,{'steps':0,'reset_failures':0})
  for i in range(400):
   s.step(); report['steps']+=1; entry['steps']+=1
   if i%100==99:
    before=s.plant.read(); steps=s.steps; history=s.history; trails=s.trails; replans=s.replans
    s.prediction(s.frames[0])
    component=s.controller if (i//100)%2==0 or s.planner is None else s.planner
    original=component.reset; error_type=KeyboardInterrupt if (report['cycles']+i//100)%2 else OSError
    error=error_type('injected reset failure')
    def fail(): raise error
    component.reset=fail
    try:
     try: s.reset()
     except BaseException as caught:
      assert caught is error
     else: raise AssertionError('reset failure was swallowed')
    finally: component.reset=original
    assert s.plant.read() is before and s.steps==steps and s.replans==replans
    assert s.history is history and s.trails is trails and s.plan is None and s.failure
    assert s.prediction(s.frames[0]).shape==(0,3)
    report['reset_failures']+=1; entry['reset_failures']+=1
    s.reset(); assert s.plant.read().stamp==0 and s.steps==0 and s.failure is None
  report['cycles']+=1
  if time.monotonic()-heartbeat>=30:
   heartbeat=time.monotonic(); print(json.dumps({'wall_s':heartbeat-started,'steps':report['steps'],'reset_failures':report['reset_failures'],'cycles':report['cycles'],'peak_rss_kib':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}),flush=True)
 report['status']='passed'
except BaseException as exc:
 report['status']='failed'; report['error']=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'; raise
finally:
 report.update(wall_s=time.monotonic()-started,peak_rss_kib=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
 output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n'); print(json.dumps(report,indent=2),flush=True)

def digest(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def read_json(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(),parse_constant=lambda x:(_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(x)))
def finite_tree(value):
 if isinstance(value,float):assert math.isfinite(value)
 elif isinstance(value,dict):
  for child in value.values():finite_tree(child)
 elif isinstance(value,list):
  for child in value:finite_tree(child)

def run(allow_pending=False,artifacts=None):
 report=read_json(ROOT/'docs/assets/optimization_20261020.json');finite_tree(report);pending=[];checked=[]
 for name,sha in report['accepted_python_source_sha256'].items():assert digest((ROOT/name).read_bytes())==sha,name
 for name,sha in report.get('validation_source_sha256',{}).items():assert digest((ROOT/name).read_bytes())==sha,name
 assert report['tests']['full']=={'passed':426,'skipped':0}
 assert '426 passed' in Path('/tmp/wholebodyx-20261020-tests-tuned-verified.log').read_text()
 for version in ('310','312'):assert '309 passed, 73 skipped' in Path('/tmp/wholebodyx-20261020-py'+version+'-verified.log').read_text()
 cohorts=[report['alpha_higher_comparison']['data'],report['alpha_lower_comparison'],report['alpha_lowest_comparison']]
 rows=[row for cohort in cohorts for row in cohort['results']]
 assert len(rows)==88 and all(row['status']=='passed' and row['solver_recoveries']==0 for row in rows)
 assert all(row['passed']==720 and not row['errors'] and row['solver_recoveries']==0 for row in report['alpha_generic_validation']['results'].values())
 assert report['alpha_selection']['selected']==1.4 and report['alpha_selection']['final_source_matches_measured_candidate']
 source_variants={'current':digest((ROOT/'python/wholebodyx/dynamics.py').read_bytes()),'pre_alpha':digest(Path('/tmp/wholebodyx-20261020-pre-alpha-dynamics.py').read_bytes()),'pre_guard':digest(Path('/tmp/wholebodyx-20261020-baseline/python/wholebodyx/dynamics.py').read_bytes())}

 def dataset(key,suffix):
  if key in report:return report[key]
  path=Path(str(PREFIX)+suffix+'.json')
  if allow_pending:
   pending.append(key)
   return read_json(path) if path.is_file() else None
  raise AssertionError('Missing finalized dataset: '+key)
 h1_specs=(('pre_guard_timing_soak','resource-baseline-14400s',14400,'pre_guard'),('pre_tuning_mpc_soak','final-mpc-18000s',18000,'pre_alpha'),('pre_tuning_wbc_soak','final-wbc-7200s',7200,'pre_alpha'),('final_mpc_soak','tuned-mpc-10800s',10800,'current'),('final_wbc_soak','tuned-wbc-7200s',7200,'current'))
 for key,suffix,seconds,variant in h1_specs:

  assert d['max_forward_contact_violation']<=1e-5 and d['max_constraint_violation']<=1e-5
  assert d['max_forward_dynamics_residual']<=1e-5 and d['max_quaternion_norm_error']<=1e-8
  assert d['solver_setups']==1 and d['solver_recoveries']==0 and d['mpc_continuity_fallbacks']==0
  for source,sha in d['source_sha256'].items():
   expected=source_variants[variant] if source=='python/wholebodyx/dynamics.py' else digest((ROOT/source).read_bytes())
   assert sha==expected,(key,source)
  timing=d['cpu_timing'];assert timing['samples']==d['steps']
  for field in ('slowest_wbc_calls','slowest_cpu_wbc_calls'):
   assert len(timing[field])==10

    assert 0<sample['sample']<=d['steps'] and all(value>=0 for value in sample['resource_delta'].values())
  checked.append(key)
 for key,suffix,seconds,step_count,failure_field,failures_per_cycle in (('session_reset_soak','session-soak',10800,400,'reset_failures',4),('scenario_switch_soak','scenario-soak',5400,501,'failed_switches',2)):
  d=dataset(key,suffix)

  finite_tree(d);assert d['status']=='passed' and d['wall_s']>=seconds
  assert d['steps']==step_count*d['cycles'] and d[failure_field]==failures_per_cycle*d['cycles']
  assert len(d['combinations'])==(20 if key=='session_reset_soak' else 4)
  assert sum(x['steps'] for x in d['combinations'].values())==d['steps']
  assert sum(x[failure_field] for x in d['combinations'].values())==d[failure_field]
  for source,sha in d['source_sha256'].items():
   expected=report['reset_soak_intermediate_source_sha256'] if key=='session_reset_soak' and source=='python/wholebodyx/session.py' else digest((ROOT/source).read_bytes())

  checked.append(key)
 monitor=dataset('wall_monitor','wall-monitor')
 if monitor is not None:

 if artifacts is not None:

   for source in required:assert archive.extractfile('wholebodyx-0.1.0/'+source).read()==(ROOT/source).read_bytes(),source

 return {'status':'pending' if pending else 'passed','checked':checked,'pending':pending}
